heading_en: Buckets, Risk Weights and Correlations for Vega Risk
summary_ja: 各リスク・クラスのベガ・リスクについて、バケット分類、リスク・ウェイト、リスク・ファクター間及びバケット間の相関係数をデルタ・リスクの規定の準用等により定める。
summary_en: Sets the bucket classification, risk weights and correlation coefficients (between risk factors and between buckets) for vega risk of each risk class, largely by applying the delta risk provisions mutatis mutandis.
paragraphs: For vega risk of each risk class, risk factors shall be classified into buckets as provided in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: Article 263-2, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: Article 263-3, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): Article 263-4, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): Article 263-5, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (v) Equity risk: Article 264, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (vi) Commodity risk: Article 264-2, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (vii) Foreign exchange risk: paragraph (1) of the preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk".

The risk weights used for vega risk of each risk class shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of risk class listed in the upper column of the same table. {{T:p383t0}}

The correlation coefficient (ρ_{kl}) between risk factors used for vega risk of each risk class shall be calculated as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: it shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p383i0}}. (ii) Risk classes other than general interest rate risk: it shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p383i1}}

The values of {{F:p384i0}}, {{F:p384i1}} and {{F:p384i2}} in the formulas in the items of the preceding paragraph shall be calculated as prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of correlation coefficient. (i) {{F:p384i3}}: it shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p384i4}} α is 1%; T_{k} is the number of years until the option exercise date of option product k; T_{l} is the number of years until the option exercise date of option product l; exp(x) is the value obtained by raising the base of the natural logarithm to the x-th power. (ii) {{F:p384i5}}: it shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p384i6}} α is 1%; {{F:p384i7}} is the number of years of the contract period of the interest rate derivative underlying option product k; {{F:p384i8}} is the number of years of the contract period of the interest rate derivative underlying option product l; exp(x) is the value obtained by raising the base of the natural logarithm to the x-th power. (iii) {{F:p384i9}}: the correlation coefficient applied between the delta risk factors corresponding to vega risk factor k and vega risk factor l shall be used.

Notwithstanding Article 260-2, paragraph (4) and the preceding two paragraphs, for the aggregation of risk-weighted sensitivities within the same bucket for vega risk of each risk class, where the bucket falls under bucket number 16 in the table in Article 263-3, paragraph (1), item (i), bucket number 16 in the table in Article 263-4, paragraph (1), item (i), bucket number 25 in the table in Article 263-5, paragraph (1), item (i) or bucket number 11 in the table in Article 264, paragraph (1), item (i), the aggregation shall be calculated by the following formula. {{F:p384i10}}

The correlation coefficient (γ_{bc}) between buckets used for vega risk of each risk class shall be as provided in each of the following items according to the following categories of risk class. (i) General interest rate risk: Article 263-2, paragraph (7) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (ii) Credit spread risk on non-securitization products: Article 263-3, paragraphs (7) and (8) apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (7) of that Article shall be read as "vega risk". (iii) Credit spread risk on securitization products (CTP): Article 263-4, paragraphs (5) and (6) apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (5) of that Article shall be read as "vega risk". (iv) Credit spread risk on securitization products (non-CTP): Article 263-5, paragraphs (6) and (7) apply mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in paragraph (6) of that Article shall be read as "vega risk". (v) Equity risk: Article 264, paragraph (5) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (vi) Commodity risk: Article 264-2, paragraph (6) applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk". (vii) Foreign exchange risk: paragraph (4) of the preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis. In this case, the term "delta risk" in that paragraph shall be read as "vega risk".
